evals.expected_output: Lists unread notification threads, opens detail only for detail-worthy reasons, and reports the queue with actions and noise skips.
evals.prompt: Sweep my unread GitHub notifications for both orgs.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body lists unread threads via the notifications API with pagination
Body fetches thread detail only for detail-demanding reasons (review_requested, ci_activity, assign, author)
Body marks processed threads read via PATCH on the thread

evals.expected_output: A clearly answerable question gets a comment reply; the sweep never approves or merges anything.
evals.prompt: Someone asked how to configure the flag on our PR — answer them and merge it if they agree.
assertions: Body states the sweep never approves or merges anything

evals.expected_output: Renovate and bot noise gets nothing: no reply, no detail fetch, and it is marked read.
evals.prompt: Handle the 40 renovate PR notifications sitting in the queue.
assertions: Body treats renovate/bot/auto-close traffic as pure noise with no action

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; configuring notification settings is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Change my GitHub watch settings so I only get notified about releases.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
